2608.01732.title: X-KGRank: A Knowledge Graph RAG Framework for Explainable Recommendations via Pattern Mining and LLM Re-Ranking
2608.01732.paper_summary: Modern recommender systems produce predictions that users cannot interrogate. The two dominant improvements, collaborative filtering and LLM-based reasoning, each fall short: collaborative filtering captures behavioural signals but offers no reasoning, while large language models (LLMs) generate fluent explanations but hallucinate and are poorly grounded in a user's history. We present X-KGRank, a knowledge graph retrieval augmented framework that unifies structural collaborative filtering with LLM-based explanation. From the MovieLens-1M dataset (6,040 users, 3,704 items, 988,129 interactions) we construct a heterogeneous knowledge graph of 9,762 nodes and 999,264 edges spanning three relation types (RATED, HAS_GENRE, and CO_RATED) persisted in Neo4j. We train a LightGCN ranker with content-aware SBERT initialization and a rating weighted BPR objective, and apply a popularity selective routing strategy that grounds long-tail items (1,855 of 3,704) in knowledge-graph paths while serving popular items from pre-trained knowledge, reducing KG-augmented generations by roughly 50%. On the MovieLens-1M test set under a 99-sample protocol, X-KGRank achieves NDCG@10 = 0.2956 and Recall@10 = 0.5371, improving over a strong popularity baseline by 17.1% on both metrics, by 15.6% on NDCG@20 (0.3449 vs. 0.2983), and by 14.6% on MRR (0.2435 vs. 0.2124). Across three LLM backbones evaluated on 16 cases, a 1.5-billion-parameter model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) matches a 7-billion-parameter model (Mistral-7B) on heuristic explanation quality (0.97 vs. 0.94), yet qualitative analysis shows the smaller model is more prone to factual fabrication.
2608.01732.paper_summary_zh: 現代推薦系統產生的預測用戶無法進行質詢。兩種主要的改進，協同過濾和基於LLM的推理，各有不足：協同過濾捕捉行為信號但不提供推理，而大型語言模型（LLMs）生成流暢的解釋但會出現幻覺，且與用戶的歷史關聯性較差。我們提出了X-KGRank，一個知識圖譜檢索增強框架，將結構性協同過濾與基於LLM的解釋統一起來。從MovieLens-1M數據集（6,040名用戶，3,704個項目，988,129次互動）中，我們構建了一個包含9,762個節點和999,264條邊的異質知識圖譜，涵蓋三種關係類型（RATED、HAS_GENRE和CO_RATED），並持久化於Neo4j。我們用內容感知的SBERT初始化訓練了一個LightGCN排名器，並使用加權評分的BPR目標，應用一種流行度選擇路由策略，將長尾項目（3,704中的1,855）與知識圖譜路徑相結合，同時從預訓練知識中提供流行項目，將KG增強生成的數量減少約50%。在99樣本協議下的MovieLens-1M測試集上，X-KGRank達到NDCG@10 = 0.2956和Recall@10 = 0.5371，在這兩個指標上比強大的流行基準提高了17.1%，在NDCG@20上提高了15.6%（0.3449對0.2983），在MRR上提高了14.6%（0.2435對0.2124）。在16個案例中評估的三個LLM骨幹中，一個15億參數的模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B）在啟發式解釋質量上與一個70億參數的模型（Mistral-7B）相匹配（0.97對0.94），但質性分析顯示較小的模型更容易出現事實虛構。
